steps: Enter ${APP_USER} in the Username field; Enter ${APP_PASS} in the Password field; Click the Next button; Click the Home button

Click the Home button; Click My Client Groups; Click the New Person button; Click the Hire an Employee link; Wait for Hire Reason; Select Hire to fill vacant position from the Hire Reason list; Select US1 Legal Entity from the Legal Employer list; Enter ${last_name} in the Last Name field; Enter ${first_name} in the First Name field; Enter ${date_of_birth} in the Date of Birth field; Click the Next button; Enter ${address} in the Address Line 1 field; Enter ${zip} in the ZIP Code field; Enter ${state} in the State field; Enter ${city} in the City field; Enter ${county} in the County field; Click the Next button; Click the Business Unit field; Enter ${business_unit} in the Business Unit field; Click the Next button; Wait for Salary Information; Click the Next button; Wait for Hire an Employee: Review; Click the Submit button; Click Yes
